articles.title: Show HN: Live AI music sequencing agent
articles.summary: Pretzel is an experiment in live AI agents for music. It's a web synchronized music sequencer that is controlled by an AI agent. Everyone chats with the same AI agent and hears the same music at any time. I'm no audio engineer so it's a pretty basic tune, and turns out audio is a pretty complex 3d function.I went to Google's IO hackathon yesterday without any idea of what I was going to work on.
